source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original QR exporter returned SVG data URIs. Selected context-only entry 1195 changes renderQR to bmp-uri and changes the display to pixelated bitmap rendering. Current code and test MIME checks agree on BMP. The wizard field comment and getQRCodes return description still say SVG, so those comments are stale evidence. Manual documentation proposal: when an output format changes, update public return descriptions and private field comments as well as assertions and display CSS. No live image quality or scanning check was run.
title: Use the accepted bitmap renderer and verify documentation against it
